entries.name: Peter Lumsdaine

expected_cases.charges: Rockwell satellite action — initial pretrial detention
expected_cases.sentence: Initial detention from May 10, 1992 ended on bail in mid-June 1992, according to the Plowshares chronology, printed page 50. June 1 is a MONTH-precision storage placeholder, not the actual release day. Electronic monitoring followed. The two-year sentence imposed September 21, 1992 belongs to later custody; its separate federal endpoint was March 2, 1994. No continuous May 1992–March 1994 interval is asserted.

case.charges: Rockwell satellite action — later federal sentence and custody endpoint
case.sentence: Two-year federal sentence imposed September 21, 1992. The Plowshares chronology documents earlier bail in June 1992 and transfer to a halfway house in December 1993. BOP register 94359-012 records actual federal release March 2, 1994, corroborating the chronology release month. This endpoint includes the later halfway-house phase; it is not the prison-to-halfway-house transfer date. Exact readmission after bail and exact December transfer day remain unverified. The initial detention is recorded separately; no uninterrupted May 1992–March 1994 duration is counted.

sources: Arthur J. Laffin, The Plowshares Disarmament Chronology 1980-2003, printed p.50 / PDF p.62.
entries.rationale: Separate later federal endpoint from initial detention; preserve bail gap and distinguish halfway-house phase.
